to.implementation_strategy: Reuse-first: extend core/capability_packs.py and config/capability-packs.json with a new 'sensor' capability pack entry. Reuse core/capability_bridge.py for pack-to-agent wiring. Extend core/intake_adapters.py with ingest adapter contract implementations (MQTT, serial, BLE, Modbus, CAN, HTTP, CSV/Parquet). to.rationale: High confidence because the item is very well specified with clear acceptance criteria and a strong candidate-code reuse list. All named models (IsolationForest, DLinear, N-BEATS, PatchTST, TimesNet, Chronos, Moirai) are permissive (MIT/Apache) — confirm Chronos and Moirai licenses.
Grafana stays external per item constraint — no embedding needed.
CSV/Parquet replay is sufficient for deterministic CI testing without live hardware.
risks: Many third-party IoT libraries (paho-mqtt, pyserial, bleak, pymodbus, python-can) expand dependency surface and compatibility risk.

MQTT/serial/BLE hardware cannot be tested in CI without fakes — fake-broker testing is required but non-trivial.
Scope is large (6 ingest adapters + store + multiple models + agent) — risk of an over-long PR.
